articles.title: Could Tiny Changes in Physics Make Life Impossible?
articles.summary: Scientists found that if the rules of physics were even a tiny bit different, water and blood might not flow right. Life as we know it might never have started.

articles.title: Is Your Pet a Genius? The Wall Test Won't Tell You!
articles.summary: That viral TikTok wall test for dogs and cats is not a real IQ test. Experts say it's just a reflex check, and holding your pet like that might scare them.

articles.title: This New Steel Could Make Clean Energy from Seawater!
articles.summary: Scientists in Hong Kong invented a super stainless steel that doesn't rust easily, even in salty seawater. It could help make cheap, clean hydrogen fuel.
